data.exact_reserve_text:
There were no issues arising from our closed years being 2007 to 2012 and all of these years combined produced a surplus which contributed both to the calendar year result and the closing 2013 account result.

At thirty-six months the account has produced a pure loss and prior year underwriting profit together with a small amount of investment income.Overall the result is a profit of $0.05 million (which equates to GBP 0.03 million) which is 0.1% of a stamp capacity of GBP 30 million.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Closed years 2007-2012 combined produced a surplus which contributed to the calendar year result and the closing 2013 account result.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened the year with gross claims outstanding of 40.081 million (USD).  The report notes surplus run-off from closed years (2007-2012) which contributed favorably to results, but the report does not disclose an explicit gross prior-year reserve movement amount.  The underwriting commentary highlights favorable prior-year development on closed years and reliance on reinsurance programmes for certain energy losses, while broader market and commodity price (oil) movements affected exposure and premium.  Overall the reserve movement picture is mixed with evidence of favourable development on older closed years but no consolidated gross PYD figure disclosed.
raw_causal_phrases: There were no issues arising from our closed years being 2007 to 2012 and all of these years combined produced a surplus which contributed both to the calendar year result and the closing 2013 account result.
one offshore energy loss of note, which attaches to our reinsurance programme.
The dominant issue during the year, which has affected both our cargo and offshore energy lines, has been the collapse of the global oil price during 2015.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding sourced from Note 12 'Claims Outstanding' (At 1 January 2015 = 40,081 $'000). The report does not provide an explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement (movement in prior year's provision) figure; claims-incurred rows (e.g. 'Claims incurred in prior underwriting year') exist but per instructions are NOT prior-year reserve movement and were therefore not used. No gross prior-year movement note was found; prior-year movement is returned as null. All monetary amounts are reported in the report's presentational currency (USD) and expressed in millions. Loss-ratio development table is available (gross percentages) but no per-underwriting-year gross premium schedule was available to convert those ratios into absolute gross reserve movements.
